Standard exercism bottle-song. Implementation:

- For each verse from startBottles down to startBottles - takeDown + 1:
  - Line 1: "{N} green bottle(s) hanging on the wall,"
  - Line 2: same as above
  - Line 3: "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,"
  - Line 4: "There'll be {n-1} green bottle(s) hanging on the wall."
- Separate verses with an empty string.

Numbers: 10→Ten, 9→Nine, 8→Eight, 7→Seven, 6→Six, 5→Five, 4→Four, 3→Three, 2→Two, 1→One, 0→no.

Singular/plural: 1 bottle, otherwise bottles.

Wait a sec — regarding the placement of the empty string: in the expected output, an empty string is appended after each verse, but not after the last verse. My loop: for n from startBottles down to startBottles-takeDown+1. After each verse, if n > startBottles-takeDown, I append "". For the last verse, n = startBottles-takeDown+1, which is greater than startBottles-takeDown, so I end up appending "" after the last verse too! This is wrong.

Let me double-check: the last n in the loop is startBottles - takeDown + 1. Condition: n > startBottles - takeDown → startBottles - takeDown + 1 > startBottles - takeDown → true. In other words, "" gets appended after the last verse too. This is wrong.

Fix: only append "" between verses, i.e., when n > startBottles - takeDown + 1 (i.e., when there are more verses remaining).
